user_request: Deploy a FastAPI application with MongoDB database. FastAPI on port 8000, MongoDB on 27017.
generated_config:
name: fastapi-demo
services:
  fastapi:
    image: tiangolo/uvicorn-gunicorn-fastapi:python3.11
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    environment:
      PYTHON_ENV: production
    depends_on:
      - mongodb
  mongodb:
    image: mongo:7
    ports:
      - "27017:27017"
    environment:
      MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME: admin
      MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD: admin123
    volumes:
      - mongodb_data:/data/db
volumes:
  mongodb_data:
